timeline.summary: Worzel planeswalks to Ergamon, detects Thomil, and duels him with braided leylines, summoning sprites and bears and casting lightning; Thomil answers with black magic and zombies; she stalls with a blue storm.
timeline.quote: used a red leyline to evoke lightning bolts against Thomil

citation.text: "Worzel", section "Gathering leylines on Ergamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thomil summons a Lord of the Pit; Worzel finally finds a white leyline and casts Circle of Protection: Black, withstanding the demon.
timeline.quote: Finally, with a white leyline, Worzel cast a Circle of Protection: Black
